title: Phenethylamine psychedelics — 2C / NBOMe / DOx
disclaimer: Fictional game catalog research. Unitless 0-100 inferences from public reports. Not a manual. No recipes. No precursors. No how-to-take. No milligram instructions. Pleasure and compulsiveness are independent. Unknown scores are null, never 0.

scoring.psych_style: The hit is enjoyment/euphoria first. Rush usually low/unknown. Compulsiveness usually low unless evidenced. Negatives below (duration hang, anxiety, NBOMe death-if-mislabel).

scope.include_18: Entire documented 2C family if substantiated (PiHKAL + circulated + named paper/forensic). No invented empty-R T-rows.
scope.include_19: NBOMe/NBOH/NBF/NBMD/related N-benzyl. Receptor stack separated from human/tox stack. High OD if sold as acid.
scope.include_20: DOx headliners + Bromo-DragonFLY scare + related long psychedelic amps (Aleph, TMA-2, DOET, etc.).
scope.ui_vs_research: UI still ships product_families short boards. This file lists the long tail as museum.

alias_validations.label: tusi / pink cocaine
alias_validations.note: Color/marketing. Usually ketamine ± extras. Not 2C-B. mislabel on the name.

alias_validations.label: Nexus / Venus / Erox / Performax / Afro / Spectrum
N-bomb / Smiles / 25I
alias_validations.note: DEA street names for 25I-NBOMe; sometimes used for the whole trio.

alias_validations.label: 2C-B-FLY vs Bromo-DragonFLY
alias_validations.note: Different molecules. Short FLY is 2c_b_fly. Scare bottle is bromo_dragonfly.

slider_board.rush_note: All low. βk-2C-B a bit more grind. DOx/BDF shrug.
slider_board.compulsiveness_note: All low unless evidenced. Party 2C-B redose is the high water. DOx/BDF nights are already too long.

receptor_vs_human.rule: Receptor data and human reports are separate stacks, especially assignment 19.
receptor: 2Cs: 5-HT2A partial agonists, not MDMA-type releasers (Rickli / Eshleman / Luethi).
NBOMe: N-benzyl boosts 5-HT2A vs parent 2C. Cimbi-5=25I-NBOMe, Cimbi-36=25B-NBOMe.
NBOH can look like parent 2C on hot GC (Arantes).
Rodent reinforcement for some 2C/NBOMe is lab, not a compulsiveness score.
human: No controlled NBOMe human psychopharm as of Poulie 2020.
25I/B/C dominate seizures and deaths; often sold as LSD.

coverage.strength: 2C-B and the NBOMe three triangulate papers + seizures + forums. DOM has a historical record. DOC mislabel is an EU alert.
coverage.weakness: Most T-grid / G-series / NB3OMe names are book chemistry. NBOMe feel is contaminated by LSD expectation. 2C-B identity is poisoned by tusi. BDF and 2C-B-FLY still get swapped.

one_liners.2c_b: Festival. The 2C that isn't a warning label.

one_liners.doc: If the '2C-B' lasts until Monday, it was DOC.
one_liners.bromo_dragonfly: If they said FLY and the sun came up twice, run.
one_liners.2c_d: Training wheels. You can still hear the DJ.
one_liners.tusi: Pink is a color. It is not 2C-B.

gaps: Almost no modern controlled 2C human data except small 2C-B studies.
NBOMe human pharmacology is absent; scores are tox + forum.
2C-C / 2C-P rodent reinforcement should not be copied into compulsiveness.
tusi keeps poisoning 2C-B identity.
NBOH GC to 2C mis-ID will keep confusing labs and NPCs.
BDF vs 2C-B-FLY vs DOB blotter — three bottles, one street word.
Later Trachsel / Cybin 2C-T-36-type names are pharma, not Flask.
Escaline / proscaline / allylescaline are 3,4,5 PEAs — not 2C. Left for assignment 30.
Do not auto-clone 25I scores onto 25P or 25T7.
